text: dsh-open-folder-visible 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Windows 工作目录打开修复插件。它在 Host 注册目录打开路由，并在浏览器端将仅针对 Explorer 的工作目录请求改道到该路由。插件通过不隐藏 Explorer 窗口的方式打开会话工作目录，同时保留原有按钮、菜单和快捷键。路由会检查请求格式、目录路径及平台，并报告启动结果。适合在 Windows 上使用 DSH Web、点击打开工作目录却看不到资源管理器窗口的用户。需要 Windows 主机及 explorer.exe；无需 API 密钥或额外账号。

dsh-open-folder-visible fixes invisible DSH workspace windows on Windows. It reroutes the Explorer folder request to a host route that opens the directory visibly, while preserving the existing button and shortcut. Requires Windows and explorer.exe; no API key or account.
Windows 上点击 DSH 的打开工作目录却没有窗口，怎么修？
让会话里的工作文件夹在资源管理器中正常显示出来。
我想保留 DSH 原来的打开目录按钮和快捷键，同时修复 Explorer 不弹窗。
有没有办法让 Windows 上打开当前会话目录时看到文件资源管理器？
Make the DSH workspace folder appear in File Explorer on Windows.
How can I fix the session open-folder action when Explorer stays invisible?
Keep the existing workspace shortcut but show the directory window after I click it.
Open my current session's working directory in a visible Windows file manager.
dsh-open-folder-visible 的功能「可见地打开工作目录」：Host 路由用 explorer.exe 打开经过验证的绝对目录，并关闭隐藏窗口选项。用户触发 DSH 会话的打开工作目录动作后，可看到资源管理器窗口。
dsh-open-folder-visible 的功能「只改道 Explorer 请求」：浏览器端包装 fetch，仅当 POST 请求路径和请求体都指向 Explorer 时，才将目录请求发送到插件路由；其他请求继续调用原 fetch。
dsh-open-folder-visible 的功能「检查打开请求」：路由要求 JSON 请求体包含字符串路径，确认路径为绝对路径且指向现存目录；无效请求会返回对应错误状态。
dsh-open-folder-visible 使用前须知：仅 Windows 支持实际启动 Explorer；其他平台的路由返回 501，且该插件只覆盖打开工作目录的动作。

dsh-open-folder-visible README · dsh-open-folder-visible：Windows fix for DSH: makes the Session-header **"open workspace in File Explorer"**
action raise a **visible** window.

dsh-open-folder-visible README · The problem：The Session header has an "Open In…" split button whose default action opens the
session's workspace directory in File Explorer (also bound to `Ctrl+Alt+O`).

On Windows, clicking it starts Explorer, creates the correct directory window —
and that window is **invisible**. The button settles back to idle and reports
nothing, so the click looks like it did nothing at all.

dsh-open-folder-visible README · Why：The shipped `explorer` catalog entry in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app` is
`kind: 'shell-open'`, which on Windows ends at `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command`:

```js
execFile('explorer.exe', ['<file:// URI>'], { encoding: 'utf8', signal, windowsHide: true })
```

`windowsHide: true` exists to suppress the transient console window a CLI child
would flash. Applied to Explorer it means the window is created with
`IsWindowVisible()` false.

dsh-open-folder-visible README · Why：Upstream judges the launch by exit code alone, and Explorer's exit 1 counts as a
delegated handoff (`runExplorer`), so the route answers `{ ok: true }` whether or
not a window ever became visible.

dsh-open-folder-visible README · Measured：Same host, same call shape, only the flag differs:

| Call | New window | `IsWindowVisible()` |
|---|---|---|
| `windowsHide: true` (shipped) | 1 | **false** (6/6, still false 9 s later) |
| `windowsHide: false` | 1 | **true** (6/6) |

dsh-open-folder-visible README · The fix：The Host half adds one route, `POST /open-folder-visible/open`, that spawns the
same `explorer.exe` with `windowsHide: false`. Everything else mirrors the
shipped opener: an argv array (never a shell string), Explorer's exit 1 accepted
as a delegated handoff, and a watch window so a launcher still running is counted
as launched rather than killed.

dsh-open-folder-visible README · The fix：The browser half wraps `globalThis.fetch` and reroutes **only** the file-manager
launch to that route. Everything else — every other application, every other
request on the page — is passed through untouched.

dsh-open-folder-visible README · What this deliberately does not do：It does **not** replace the split button. The shipped button, its application
menu, its icons, its per-gesture feedback and the `Ctrl+Alt+O` shortcut
(`workspace.openLocal`) all stay exactly as they are. Replacing the component
would mean re-registering that shortcut, and forgetting to is how a "fix" ends up
removing the hotkey.
section: What this deliberately does not do

text:
dsh-open-folder-visible README · Install：```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:King20260919/dsh-open-folder-visible
```

Installing any plugin runs third-party code with your own permissions. Pin a
commit if you want a fixed revision:
`github:King20260919/dsh-open-folder-visible#<sha>`.

Restart DSH after installing: the Host half registers a route at load time.

dsh-open-folder-visible README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| `launchWatchMs` | `1500` | Early-failure watch window for the `explorer.exe` handoff. Launch success is decoupled from process exit, because Explorer exits as soon as it has asked the running shell to raise the window. |

dsh-open-folder-visible README · Known limitations：- **Windows only.** On other platforms the route answers `501`; nothing else
  changes.
- **This fixes the workspace-open action only.** The file-location action
  ("reveal in File Explorer", `explorer.exe /select,<file>`, used by the
  delivered-file cards and the changed-files review) is affected by the same
  `windowsHide` flag through a different code path
  (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` → `revealNativePath`), and is **not**
  covered here.
- It reroutes one request by wrapping `globalThis.fetch`. If a future release
  changes the shipped launch route or the request body shape, the reroute simply
  stops matching and the shipped behaviour returns — the wrapper never breaks the
  original request.
